WGCNA on grape TagSeq data

The WGCNA analysis was conducted using log2 counts per million reads, and included all genes included in the DE analysis.

The analysis used a signed network and the robust biweight midcorrelation. A soft-thresholding power of 36 was chosen by the WGCNA function pickSoftThreshold as the smallest power for which the scale-free topology index exceeded 0.85. However, as the module detection function allows a maximum power of 30, 30 was used as the soft thresholding power. The scale-free topology index for a power of 30 was 0.82.

14 modules were identified, each of which included the following numbers of genes (note that the “grey” module represents unclustered genes):

## 
##      salmon         tan greenyellow      purple     magenta        pink 
##          24          35          98         103         179         218 
##       black         red       green      yellow       brown        blue 
##         224         373         405         475        1001        2370 
##   turquoise        grey 
##        2495        7897

Clustering dendrogram of genes, with dissimilarity based on topological overlap, together with assigned module colors

GO enrichment analyses of module genes were conducted using clusterProfiler.
